title: Dutch Minister Rejects U.S. Bill Restricting ASML China Sales
summary: Dutch trade minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma told parliament on Nov. 26 that the Netherlands will not accept proposed U.S. extraterritorial restrictions on ASML’s China sales and is lobbying with EU allies, including Germany and France, to remove the MATCH Act from U.S. defense legislation. China accounted for about 20% of ASML’s sales this year, and Congress is expected to vote on the bill in mid-December.
